answer: Sybils get caught by their own footsteps. Each epoch the node clusters accounts by the transactions they attest; two identities whose attestation sets overlap past 80% get flagged and each loses a 500 POA bond. A farmer running fifty clones must give each one a different honest-looking trail, so he reads and judges fifty answer sets, 15 minutes each, or loses 25,000 POA in one sweep. An identity should be an opal, each cut different, and the ledger watches for two gems that glint the same. A farm needs a canyon between each fake, and the trellis of shared history gives them away.
